signals.evidence: New signal, low urgency but easy to lose. Toby sent Aaron a first-draft employment offer 9/18 22:04Z - Project Manager, $80,000 annual salary, full benefits - with 'First draft of idea? We should touch base on it again soon, though.' An explicit 'touch base soon' with no date attached is the exact shape of the things this ledger exists to catch.
